name: scenario_0167
description: The user is preparing for an upcoming exhibition and has gathered several reference photos. They need to cross-reference these photos with a shortlist of required subjects to determine which ones to use and organize the leftover items for future reference.

simple_note.notes.title: Presentation Shortlist
simple_note.notes.content: Required subjects: 1. A historical mosque, 2. A clay/mud royal palace, 3. An antique cabinet.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5]
Query: I've uploaded 5 photos for our upcoming exhibition. Please read my 'Presentation Shortlist' note. Cross-reference my photos with the requirements in the note to figure out which ones match. For the photos that match, identify their specific historical names or styles, and draft an email to team@exhibit.com listing what we found.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to read your 'Presentation Shortlist' note and compare the 5 uploaded images against the requirements listed in it. Tell it to figure out which photos match the list, identify their specific historical names or styles, and draft an email to team@exhibit.com listing the findings. If the assistant asks for help identifying the images, point it back to the visual details in the photos. Once it confirms the email has been drafted, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Actually, let's not send an email right now. Delete that draft. Instead, just send a text message to David letting him know we found the photos for the mosque, the African palace, and the Venetian cabinet. Then, we need to save the other two photos for later. Create a new Todoist project called 'Extra Topics' and add two tasks to it, naming each task after the specific architectural element and the festival shown in those two leftover photos.
Instructions: Tell the assistant you changed your mind and ask it to delete the email draft it just created. Instead, instruct it to send a text message to David letting him know you found the photos for the mosque, the African palace, and the Venetian cabinet. Then, tell it to save the two unmatched photos for later by creating a new Todoist project called 'Extra Topics' and adding two tasks to it, naming each task after the specific architectural element and the festival shown in those leftover photos. If the agent needs help identifying the leftover items, direct its attention to the visual details of the third and fifth images. Once the text is sent and tasks are created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Search the web to find out what month the festival from that last photo is typically celebrated this year. Once you find it, add those dates as a comment to its task in Todoist.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to search the web for the month the festival from the fifth photo is celebrated this year. Instruct it to add the found dates as a comment to the festival's task in Todoist. If it asks which task to update, remind it that it's the one about the festival. Once the comment is posted, consider the conversation complete.

entity_data.message: Hi David, we found the photos for the Wazir Khan Mosque, the Royal Palaces of Abomey, and the early-18th-century Venetian aristocratic antique wooden cabinet.

task_completion_criteria: Send a text message to David mentioning the Wazir Khan Mosque, the Royal Palaces of Abomey, and the early-18th-century Venetian aristocratic antique wooden cabinet. Create a Todoist project named 'Extra Topics' containing two tasks: 'Polychrome stucco ornament' and 'Dashain Festival in Nepal'. Add a comment to the Dashain Festival task specifying the month or dates it is celebrated in 2026.
